title: Side Panel Tab Bar Clipping
description: Fix Document tab left clipping in side panels and establish a clean shared mechanism for rendering panel tab bars in React SidePanel/MobilePanel and WGPU floating panels.
summary: Fixed Document tab left clipping in side panels by introducing a shared tab-bar mechanism in both renderers. React: new PanelTabBar component used by SidePanel and MobilePanel, tab strip raised to z-40 above the chrome frame, horizontal inset padding, min-w-0 labels, and scroll reset. WGPU: extracted render_panel_tab_bar with hairline inset + scissor, moved panel borders inside glass foreground before tabs so overlay pass no longer paints over tab labels.
